rollups.text: Evan’s documented travel and outdoor activities: family Rockies hiking trip in May 2023 (2023-05-08..2023-05-14); family road trip to Jasper via the Icefields Parkway (2023-05-20..2023-05-21); drove to Banff and skied (2023-07); vacation in Canada with his new significant other, including hiking and biking (2023-07-31..2023-08-13); road trip to the Rocky Mountains (2023-07); camping trip with kayaking and a lake sunset (2023-06-01..2023-08-31); snowshoeing with his partner (2024-01-06..2024-01-07); planned Canada honeymoon with skiing and local cuisine, including poutine (2024-02). Evan also enjoys hiking, skiing, snowboarding, ice skating, kayaking, and beach outings.

Evan’s recurring hobbies and interests include watercolor and other painting (documented from before 2023-05-18 through 2023-12-26), fitness and weightlifting (weightlifting began around 2022-10; gym and walking also documented in 2023), hiking, skiing, snowboarding, ice skating, and driving for relaxation. He began painting classes around 2023-08-16, studied watercolor, and painted landscapes and figurative work; a painting was accepted for exhibition by 2023-12-17. He also enjoys nature, beach sunsets, and caring for a bonsai tree (2023-08-07).

Evan’s documented vehicles and related events: an old Prius broke down and he decided to repair and sell it (date unspecified); he owned a new Prius by May 2023, which broke down in December 2023; he and others drove their Prius to the mountains and had a minor accident on the return trip (2023-12-23..2023-12-24). Evan also drove for relaxation and took road trips in his car.

Evan’s health and fitness efforts: he began lifting weights around 2022-10 and said he was starting to see gains (2023-10-08); he described a prior health struggle and diet changes from roughly 2021 (2023-07-21, 2023-10-25). A sudden palpitation incident frightened him and prompted greater attention to lifestyle and processed and sugary foods (2023-05-30..2023-06-06). He said he had been working on his health for two years, with ups and downs, and used family motivation and a smartwatch to track progress (2023-08-07). He continued gym workouts and walking and reported strength gains (2023-10-17, 2023-10-25). A suspicious check-up finding caused a hospital visit and health scare; doctors later clarified it was a misunderstanding and everything was fine (2023-11-13..2023-11-19). By January 2024 he was limiting himself to two ginger snaps per day and trying healthier snacks (2024-01-06..2024-01-10).

Evan’s knee injury and recovery: he twisted his knee around 2023-08-25; by 2023-08-27 it was very painful and interrupted his usual fitness routine, and he was considering physical therapy and planned low-key activity and swimming. After another reported knee injury while playing basketball with his children in the week before 2023-10-06, he said physical therapy had helped somewhat and he was doing easy exercises, but avoiding intense workouts. The records do not establish whether these reports concern one continuing injury or separate injuries.

Evan’s painting development: he had painted for years and was introduced to watercolor by a friend (by 2023-05-18). Around 2023-08-16 he started painting classes to improve, meet like-minded people, and stay creative; he enjoyed watercolor lessons and painting landscapes. By 2023-10-06 he described painting as a stress reliever and a way to express feelings and memories. In December he completed a contemporary figurative painting and a close female friend helped get it into an exhibition (2023-12-17).

Evan’s relationship and family milestones: by 2023-08-07 he described an energizing relationship with a Canadian woman and later said he had returned from Canada with a new significant other (2023-07-31..2023-08-13). He told Sam his partner was pregnant on 2023-12-09. He said he married the previous week, placing the wedding between 2023-12-18 and 2023-12-24 (reported 2023-12-26); the record does not confirm whether the wife was the Canadian woman. He and his partner shared their marriage news with extended families on 2024-01-05 and felt welcomed and supported. They planned a Canada honeymoon for February 2024. Evan also planned a large family reunion for summer 2024.

Evan’s employment change: he lost his job in October 2023 when his company downsized and laid off employees. By 2023-11-09 he was looking for a new job, said the search was difficult, and remained hopeful; Sam offered support.

Evan’s documented family health incidents: his son injured his ankle playing soccer (2023-08-12; reported 2023-08-15), with the ankle improving but still sore by 2023-08-15; his son fell off a bicycle around 2023-12-12 and was doing better by 2023-12-17. Evan also reported a minor road accident with others on the return from the mountains, and said everyone involved was fine (2023-12-23..2023-12-31).

Evan said he loses his keys every week on 2023-08-13 and again called losing them a weekly ritual on 2023-12-26. These are at least two records of the recurring problem; no exact lifetime count is available.
Evan reported two distinct vehicle breakdowns: his old Prius had broken down before 2023-05-18, and his newly purchased Prius broke down on 2023-12-05.

Sam’s health and fitness efforts: A doctor’s check-up a few days before 2023-05-24 prompted concern about weight and a request for advice on healthier habits (2023-05-24; D2:6, D2:8). Sam reported trying to eat healthier on 2023-06-06, while also acknowledging no dietary changes yet and continued soda and candy habits (D3:2, D3:4). After friends mocked Sam’s weight the previous Friday, Sam said on 2023-07-21 that they were reducing soda and candy and getting active (D4:1, D4:7). Sam planned to begin regular gym exercise on 2023-07-28 (D4:14). Sam took a cooking class to learn healthier meals by 2023-08-15, then reported dieting and feeling more energetic on 2023-08-19 (D7:2, D7:4, D8:1, D8:5). Sam started a diet and exercise routine on 2023-08-21 and said by 2023-08-27 that it made a huge difference (D9:1). On 2023-10-02, a doctor warned that Sam’s weight posed a serious health risk; Sam later considered weightlifting and sought guidance (D12:1, D12:3, D12:5). A severe stomachache led to an emergency-room visit and gastritis diagnosis on 2023-10-14..2023-10-15, which Sam called a wake-up call to prioritize nutrition and exercise (D14:1). Sam later described difficulty maintaining a routine amid family pressure and impatience about results (2023-10-25; D15:1, D15:5). Sam became a Weight Watchers coach on 2023-11-09 (D16:1, D16:3). Sam said weight-related struggles were affecting confidence and motivation on 2023-12-17 (D20:8). On 2024-01-10, Sam planned a meal plan and workout schedule and intended to seek medical advice on a balanced diet and low-impact exercise; on 2024-01-11, Sam still reported health issues and difficulty finding enjoyable low-impact exercise (D24:10, D24:12, D24:14, D25:1, D25:4). The effort spans about 7 months and 20 days from the May check-up concern to the January health update.

Sam’s creative interests: On 2023-05-18, Sam was keen to try painting as a relaxing, creative hobby but had not yet tried it (D1:11, D1:13). On 2023-05-24, Sam said they would try painting without pressure (D2:10). On 2023-09-11, Sam again considered painting for stress relief, accepted Evan’s offer to help choose supplies, and agreed to paint together on 2023-09-16 (D10:8, D10:9, D10:10, D10:11, D10:12, D10:13). By 2023-10-06, Sam said they were learning to draw and found journaling and creative writing therapeutic (D11:15, D11:17, D11:19). On 2023-12-26, Sam said they sketched occasionally, had not yet made anything remarkable, and expected to have something to show soon; an art exhibit had inspired Sam a few days earlier (D21:17, D21:19). The interest develops over about 7 months and 8 days, from considering painting to reporting drawing and occasional sketching; records do not establish whether the planned joint painting took place.

Sam’s hiking and outdoor activity: Sam recalled a special, fun hike with their father at age ten (date not recorded; D1:7, D1:9). Sam said on 2023-05-18 that they loved hiking but had not gone in a long time (D1:7). On 2023-08-27, Sam said they wanted to hike more and hoped improved health would make a road trip and hike possible; Evan proposed hiking together (D9:11, D9:12). Sam and Evan agreed on 2023-10-17 to plan a hike soon, but no date or location was set (D14:6, D14:7, D14:8, D14:9, D14:10, D14:11, D14:12, D14:16). Sam took friends on a hiking trip on 2023-12-29 as part of a healthier lifestyle (D22:1). On 2023-12-17, Sam again said hiking used to be a favorite but they had not gone for a while, and Evan suggested a hike together; no specific date was set (D20:5, D20:6, D20:7).

Sam’s exercise and outdoor activities discussed or tried: hiking, which Sam loved and did with their father at age ten (age 10, date not recorded; D1:7, D1:9); gym exercise, planned to start 2023-07-28 (D4:14); a new diet-and-exercise routine, started 2023-08-21 (D9:1); skiing, which Sam wanted to try but was unsure their body could handle (2023-08-19; D8:29, D8:31, D8:33); kayaking, which Sam had not tried before and planned to try with a mate at Lake Tahoe (2023-10-14; D13:5, D13:6, D13:7, D13:8, D13:9, D13:10, D13:11); morning runs, which Sam said they had started enjoying (2023-12-26; D21:9); a hiking trip with friends (2023-12-29; D22:1); yoga, which Sam said helped flexibility and stress and recommended to Evan (2023-12-05; D18:8); and beach walks, planned after Evan’s suggestion (2024-01-10; D24:22).

Sam reported two separate self-checkout problems at a supermarket: all the machines were broken and left Sam in a terrible mood on 2023-06-06, and Sam described another self-checkout problem as an annoyance on 2023-12-31. The records span about 6 months and 25 days.

Sam reported recurring dreams of flying over skyscrapers on at least two occasions: an amazing dream described on 2023-08-13, and a recurring dream mentioned on 2024-01-10. The records span about 4 months and 28 days.

Sam’s dietary-health efforts included repeated attention to reducing soda and candy: Sam recognized these habits but had not changed them yet on 2023-06-06; said they were reducing intake on 2023-07-21; and reported ongoing cravings for sugary drinks and snacks on 2023-09-11. Sam also described giving in to unhealthy snacks on 2023-10-14, then later seeking healthy snack ideas on 2023-12-31. These records show recurring effort and difficulty rather than a fully documented lasting change.

Sam’s cooking and food experiences connected with healthier eating: tried to eat healthier and shared vegetables and milk (2023-06-06; D3:2); took a cooking class and made grilled salmon with vegetables (2023-08-15; D7:2, D7:4, D7:6); shared a spinach, avocado, and strawberry bowl and enjoyed grilled chicken-and-vegetable stir-fry with homemade sauce, offering Evan the recipe (2023-08-19; D8:1, D8:7, D8:8, D8:9, D8:10, D8:11, D8:12); attended a Weight Watchers meeting and said a fruit-and-yogurt smoothie bowl was a hit (2023-12-04; D18:6, D18:8); and asked for healthy snack ideas and planned to try Evan’s recommendation (2023-12-31; D22:13, D22:17, D22:19).

Sam’s recurring sources of comfort and motivation: nature and being outdoors, which Sam said were calming, rejuvenating, and helpful for getting fresh air (2023-12-31 and 2024-01-11; D22:9, D25:5, D25:6, D25:7, D25:11, D25:12, D25:13); supportive family, whom Sam described as their rock (2024-01-06; D23:12); and small wins and taking progress one step at a time, themes Sam endorsed during health efforts (2023-08-13 and 2023-10-25; D6:12, D15:13, D15:14, D15:15, D15:16).
